items.title: Xbox servers are back online
items.summary: Xbox servers have been restored and are working again. You should now be able to log in to your account normally. Thank you for your patience!

items.title: Xbox servers are currently down
items.summary: Xbox servers are experiencing an outage right now. If you can't log in to your account, this is not a launcher issue — it's an issue with Xbox itself. Please wait for Xbox to resolve the problem.

items.title: Android 17 compatibility issue
items.summary: LeviLauncher currently does not support Android 17. If you rely on LeviLauncher, do not update your device to Android 17 yet. Please wait until Android 17 support is announced.

items.title: Launcher news is now built in
items.summary: Tap the bell at the top of LeviLauncher to see announcements, release information, and important notices in one place.
